title: AI Dashboards and Farewell to No Agenda
description: Steven covers a Rolls-Royce stock rebound, the end of the 19-year No Agenda Show, Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro, and the Claude-built AI dashboards he's using to prep for HSK5. He finishes with his Halloween reading list of Russian horror stories by Gogol, Chekhov, Turgenev and Pushkin.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目聊的是十月底的话题：一只表现不错的劳斯莱斯股票，播了19年的《No Agenda Show》宣布停播，苹果的触屏版MacBook Pro，还有史蒂文用Claude做的AI仪表盘，其中一个专门用来备考HSK5。
sentences.en: Today's episode covers topics from late October: a Rolls-Royce stock that's been performing well, the 19-year-old "No Agenda Show" announcing it's ending, Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro, and the AI dashboards Steven built with Claude, one of which is specifically for preparing for HSK5.

sentences.zh: 最后是他今年的万圣节书单。
sentences.en: Finally, there's his Halloween reading list for this year.

sentences.zh: 这一切，都赶在晚上7点的中文课之前。
sentences.en: All of this squeezed in before the 7 p.m. Chinese class.

sentences.zh: 劳斯莱斯与十月股市
sentences.en: Rolls-Royce and the October Stock Market

sentences.zh: 人们常说“十月惊喜”，可这个月只剩两个交易日，惊喜还没露面。
sentences.en: People often talk about an "October surprise," but with only two trading days left this month, the surprise still hasn't shown up.

sentences.zh: 除了两周前科技股的一轮下跌，市场基本风平浪静。
sentences.en: Apart from a round of tech-stock declines two weeks ago, the market has been mostly calm.

sentences.zh: 照例声明：这不是投资建议，请自己做好功课。
sentences.en: The usual disclaimer: this isn't investment advice, so please do your own homework.

sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，史蒂文把劳斯莱斯（RR.L）加进了股票跟踪表：
sentences.en: Earlier this week, Steven added Rolls-Royce (RR.L) to his stock tracking sheet:

sentences.zh: 股价跌到11.75，三四天后回升到12.63
sentences.en: The share price fell to 11.75, then rebounded to 12.63 three or four days later

sentences.zh: 涨幅约9%，账面盈利约790美元
sentences.en: A gain of about 9%, roughly $790 in paper profit

sentences.zh: 周一他就提醒过，RSI已跌进超卖区
sentences.en: As early as Monday he had pointed out that the RSI had fallen into oversold territory

sentences.zh: 做期权，本金可能全部亏光。
sentences.en: With options, you could lose your entire principal.

sentences.zh: “别人恐惧时贪婪”说起来容易，“问题是，你终究得先战胜自己的恐惧。”
sentences.en: "Be greedy when others are fearful" is easy to say, but "the problem is, you ultimately have to conquer your own fear first."

sentences.zh: 告别《No Agenda Show》
sentences.en: Farewell to The No Agenda Show

sentences.zh: 《No Agenda Show》今晚在播出19年后落幕。
sentences.en: The No Agenda Show ends tonight after 19 years on the air.

sentences.zh: 主持人亚当·柯里曾是MTV主持人，约翰·德沃夏克是《PC Magazine》的老专栏作家。
sentences.en: Host Adam Curry was once an MTV host, and John C. Dvorak was a longtime columnist for PC Magazine.

sentences.zh: 两人2007年前后开办这档节目，专门拆解媒体的说法。
sentences.en: The two started the show around 2007, devoted to taking apart the media's narratives.

sentences.zh: 德沃夏克7月去世后，亚当请了一些嘉宾；如今他要专心做“播客2.0”和信仰主题的播客。
sentences.en: After Dvorak died in July, Adam brought in some guests; now he wants to focus on Podcasting 2.0 and a faith-themed podcast.

sentences.zh: 对史蒂文来说，这里就是他的新闻来源。
sentences.en: For Steven, this is where he gets his news.

sentences.zh: 节目有趣，不像大电视台那样“陈旧乏味”，他称支持者为“制作人”的点子也来自这里。
sentences.en: The show is fun, not "stale and boring" like the big TV networks, and it's also where he got the idea of calling his supporters "producers."

sentences.zh: 直播大结局在北京时间凌晨3点左右，他多半只能听一部分。
sentences.en: The live finale is around 3 a.m. Beijing time, so he'll probably only catch part of it.

sentences.zh: 改天再聊的沉重话题
sentences.en: Heavy topics to discuss another day

sentences.zh: 周日的节目引出两个大话题，史蒂文打算以后再谈。
sentences.en: Sunday's episode raised two big topics that Steven plans to discuss later.

sentences.zh: 一是信仰：他最近在读一本天主教会的历史。
sentences.en: The first is faith: he's recently been reading a history of the Catholic Church.

sentences.zh: 二是民族主义：本周姆巴佩出了风波，中国网友反应强烈，即便道歉后，他仍丢了赞助。
sentences.en: The second is nationalism: this week Mbappé got caught up in a controversy, Chinese netizens reacted strongly, and even after apologizing, he still lost a sponsorship.

sentences.zh: 爱自己的国家，分寸在哪里？
sentences.en: When it comes to loving your own country, where do you draw the line?

sentences.zh: 移居国外，又该入乡随俗到什么程度？
sentences.en: And when you move abroad, how far should you go in adapting to local customs?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得事情被放大了，不过这个话题留到以后再说。
sentences.en: Steven feels the whole thing was blown out of proportion, but this topic will be saved for later.

sentences.zh: 苹果触屏MacBook Pro
sentences.en: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro

sentences.zh: “天哪，他们真做出来了。苹果，你怎么敢？”
sentences.en: "Oh my God, they actually made it. Apple, how dare you?"

sentences.zh: 苹果一向说不会做，但在约翰·特努斯掌舵后，OLED触屏MacBook Pro还是来了。
sentences.en: Apple always said it wouldn't make one, but after John Ternus took the helm, the OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro arrived anyway.

sentences.zh: 按加元算：
sentences.en: In Canadian dollars:

sentences.zh: 14英寸基础款约5000到6000加元，或分24期，每月约500加元
sentences.en: The 14-inch base model is about 5,000 to 6,000 Canadian dollars, or about 500 Canadian dollars a month over 24 installments

sentences.zh: 顶配8TB版本约2万加元
sentences.en: The top-spec 8TB version is about 20,000 Canadian dollars

sentences.zh: 乔布斯当年看不上触屏笔记本，是因为那时的技术太笨拙。
sentences.en: Steve Jobs looked down on touchscreen laptops back then because the technology at the time was too clunky.

sentences.zh: 如今我们整天抓着手机，创作者在屏幕上指一指、拖进文件，再回到键盘快捷键，确实顺手。
sentences.en: Nowadays we're glued to our phones all day, so for creators it really is handy to tap the screen, drag in files, then go back to keyboard shortcuts.

sentences.zh: 为什么要8TB？
sentences.en: Why 8TB?

sentences.zh: 一是视频：iPhone拍45分钟1080p约占6GB，而他天天录。
sentences.en: First, video: 45 minutes of 1080p shot on an iPhone takes up about 6GB, and he records every day.

sentences.zh: 二是在本地跑AI模型。
sentences.en: Second, running AI models locally.

sentences.zh: 真的需要吗？
sentences.en: Is it really necessary?

sentences.zh: 不需要。
sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: iPhone Duo 体验
sentences.en: Trying out the iPhone Duo

sentences.zh: 史蒂文班上还没人买iPhone Duo，网上也说太贵。
sentences.en: Nobody in Steven's class has bought an iPhone Duo yet, and people online say it's too expensive.

sentences.zh: 和他的14 Pro Max相比，主要升级只是前置摄像头和USB-C。
sentences.en: Compared with his 14 Pro Max, the main upgrades are just the front camera and USB-C.

sentences.zh: 他的手机摔过无数次都安然无恙，何必换呢？
sentences.en: His phone has been dropped countless times and is still perfectly fine, so why bother switching?

sentences.zh: 终端里的Claude与AI仪表盘
sentences.en: Claude in the terminal and AI dashboards

sentences.zh: 今天早上7点53分，他打开终端，就一直坐在电脑前。
sentences.en: At 7:53 this morning, he opened the terminal and has been sitting at the computer ever since.

sentences.zh: Claude Code是“游戏规则的改变者”，他不介意用这个老套的说法。
sentences.en: Claude Code is a "game changer", and he doesn't mind using the cliché.

sentences.zh: 它又快又好用，还能同时开好几个。
sentences.en: It's fast and easy to use, and you can run several at once.

sentences.zh: 他试过在本地跑模型来保护隐私，可光是Hermes智能体就占40GB，而他的1TB硬盘还要用来剪视频，行不通。
sentences.en: He tried running models locally to protect his privacy, but the Hermes agent alone takes up 40GB, and his 1TB drive is also needed for editing videos, so it didn't work.

sentences.zh: 网上有梗说人人都在让AI“给我做个仪表盘”，但真的很棒。
sentences.en: There's a meme online that everyone is asking AI to "make me a dashboard", but it really is great.

sentences.zh: 它在三块硬盘里找出了重复文件，按他的归档习惯整理好。
sentences.en: It found duplicate files across three hard drives and organized them according to his filing habits.

sentences.zh: 现在他有了英语教学、Substack和视频片段三个仪表盘。
sentences.en: Now he has three dashboards: English teaching, Substack, and video clips.

sentences.zh: 至于他这套全“Pro”的苹果装备：“以这样的制作水准，也许你该满足于消费级版本。啪。”
sentences.en: As for his all-"Pro" Apple gear: "With production values like these, maybe you should settle for the consumer versions. Snap."

sentences.zh: 我的HSK5中文仪表盘
sentences.en: My HSK5 Chinese Dashboard

sentences.zh: 今天的项目是中文仪表盘。
sentences.en: Today's project is a Chinese dashboard.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文来中国12年了，HSK5还没学完。
sentences.en: Steven has been in China for 12 years and still hasn't finished studying HSK5.

sentences.zh: 他手头有成堆的课堂记录、词汇表、模拟试卷和手写日记，却不知从何下手。
sentences.en: He has piles of class notes, vocabulary lists, practice exams and handwritten journals on hand, but doesn't know where to start.

sentences.zh: Claude全读了一遍，还说了件他没问的事：HSK5的1298个词里，他接触过891个，亲手写过的只有88个。
sentences.en: Claude read all of it, and told him something he hadn't asked about: of the 1,298 HSK5 words, he had come across 891, but had written only 88 by hand.

sentences.zh: 随后它做出了：
sentences.en: Then it built:

sentences.zh: 24周学习计划，每周8小时，对准2026年12月13日开考的新HSK 3.0
sentences.en: A 24-week study plan, 8 hours a week, aimed at the new HSK 3.0 exam on December 13, 2026

sentences.zh: 带音频的每日闪卡（今天2个复习、13个新词，约25分钟）
sentences.en: Daily flashcards with audio (today: 2 reviews and 13 new words, about 25 minutes)

sentences.zh: 阅读链接，一点就打开PDF的对应章节，包括《三国演义》
sentences.en: Reading links that open the matching chapter of the PDF with one click, including Romance of the Three Kingdoms

sentences.zh: 写作任务：用五个词手写80个字，再对照他常犯的错误检查
sentences.en: Writing tasks: handwrite 80 characters using five words, then check against the mistakes he often makes

sentences.zh: 它取代不了老师，因为口语练习才是老师的用武之地。
sentences.en: It can't replace a teacher, because speaking practice is where a teacher really shines.

sentences.zh: 他把周二的iTalki课忘得一干二净，老师体贴地帮他改了时间。
sentences.en: He completely forgot his Tuesday iTalki lesson, and his teacher kindly rescheduled it for him.

sentences.zh: 正如他常说的：“语言只有你自己才能学会。”
sentences.en: As he often says: "Only you can teach yourself a language."

sentences.zh: 万圣节故事：今年的书单
sentences.en: Halloween story: this year's reading list

sentences.zh: 中国不怎么过万圣节这类“外来节日”，这里也没有“不给糖就捣蛋”。
sentences.en: China doesn't really celebrate "foreign holidays" like Halloween, and there's no "trick or treat" here either.

sentences.zh: 不过每年史蒂文都会读些略为小众的恐怖故事，往年读过《猴爪》和《聊斋志异》。
sentences.en: But every year Steven reads some slightly lesser-known horror stories; in past years he has read "The Monkey's Paw" and "Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio."

sentences.zh: 今年的候选篇目多来自古腾堡计划：
sentences.en: This year's candidate stories mostly come from Project Gutenberg:

sentences.zh: 果戈理：《维》《圣约翰之夜》《神秘的肖像》
sentences.en: Gogol: "Viy," "St. John's Eve," "The Portrait"

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯民间故事：《芭芭雅嘎》《美丽的瓦西丽莎》
sentences.en: Russian folk tales: "Baba Yaga," "Vasilisa the Beautiful"

sentences.zh: 契诃夫：《黑修士》
sentences.en: Chekhov: "The Black Monk"

sentences.zh: 屠格涅夫：《克拉拉·米利奇》《幻影》
sentences.en: Turgenev: "Klara Milich," "Phantoms"

sentences.zh: 普希金：《黑桃皇后》
sentences.en: Pushkin: "The Queen of Spades"

sentences.zh: 这期节目一结束，他就去录《芭芭雅嘎》和《美丽的瓦西丽莎》。
sentences.en: As soon as this episode ends, he's going to record "Baba Yaga" and "Vasilisa the Beautiful."

sentences.zh: 别指望有广播剧：“你在这里买的不是高品质，而是数量和便利。”
sentences.en: Don't expect a radio drama: "What you're buying here isn't high quality, but quantity and convenience."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: AI工具和闪亮的新Mac让学习和创作比以往轻松，但功夫还得自己下。
sentences.en: AI tools and shiny new Macs make learning and creating easier than ever, but you still have to put in the effort yourself.

sentences.zh: 有时候，这功夫就是蜷在沙发里，读一个毛骨悚然的好故事。
sentences.en: Sometimes, that effort means curling up on the couch and reading a good, spine-chilling story.

vocab.en: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
